description: React component for a searchable user list with pagination, filtering, and internationalization support, used within the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: SearchableUserList
classes.description: A React component that renders a searchable, paginated list of users with filtering options, supporting internationalization and custom row components.

methods.name: scrollToTop
methods.description: Scrolls the user list view to the top.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that focuses the search input when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that scrolls to top when page or search term changes.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the next page, disables button temporarily.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the previous page.

methods.name: focusSearchBar
methods.description: Sets focus on the search input if focusOnMount is true.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Handles input change in the search box, triggers search and term change.

methods.name: renderCount
methods.description: Renders the count of users, with support for custom render functions.
